say:12:1410253004:3.text: In short, we've ended up underground, and we're waiting for this girl to help us get back.
say:12:1410253004:3.source_cn: 总之，我们现在意外掉到了地底，正在等那个矮人带我们回去。

say:16:1410253005:0.text: I see. No wonder the dwarves are in a panic. Looks like they've discovered something's amiss.
say:16:1410253005:0.source_cn: 原来是这样。怪不得外头矮人们慌成一团，多半是发现了乱子……

say:20:1410253006:0.source_cn: 弗林他们察觉到主人不见了吗？

say:24:1410253007:0.text: Oh, he did, but I told him you all weren't feeling well. Your cover's safe for now.
say:24:1410253007:0.source_cn: 嗯，但我说梅林水土不服，糊弄过去了。
say:24:1410253007:0.male: Oh, he did, but I told him you all weren't feeling well. Your cover's safe for now.

say:25:1410253008:0.text: For now, I'm playing it cool with Chief Eldric. Everything's calm so far, so I'll continue stalling for a while.
say:25:1410253008:0.source_cn: 现在我和弗林村长互相装傻，还算安稳。我会尽力周旋一阵子——

say:26:1410253009:0.text: But <style="highlight">connecting Brimstone Village to the depths underground</style>... now that's a major discovery.

say:27:1410253010:0.text: Keep gathering intel. I'll handle the rest.
say:27:1410253010:0.source_cn: 你们先继续收集情报，我会为你们周全其他的事情。

say:28:1410253011:0.text: There's no need to rush back. Just stay safe.
say:28:1410253011:0.source_cn: 返回地面时无需着急，千万注意安全！

say:33:1410253012:0.source_cn: 你也是，霍根将军，要小心啊！
